[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that coconut milk has a strong flavor that might overpower the citrus notes in Morning Sunrise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that cashew milk has a creamy texture and a subtle, nutty flavor that can complement coffee.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering trying coconut milk or cashew milk as alternatives to oat milk.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant discussed the pros and cons of using unflavored versus flavored cashew milk in coffee.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested that unflavored cashew milk allows the natural flavors of Morning Sunrise to shine through, while flavored cashew milk can add complexity but might overpower the citrus notes.
